task.title: Charging Devices on FM Transmitter
task.shortdesc: This device includes two separate USB port for quick-charging mobile/electronic devices.

prereq.p: The only prequirement to this task is having a type-C or USB-A charging cable.

context.p: When wanting to charge your devices you can use both USB type ports for quick charging.The quick-charging feature can only be activated by using only one of the quick-charging ports at a time.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
